_comment: Advisories in the fork's own locks that do not apply to how the fork runs them (E7). Every entry needs a reason and a review date; fork/scripts/lock-audit.py fails when an entry stops matching, so stale exceptions cannot linger.

exceptions.reason: X-CLIP checkpoint conversion. The trial converts nothing: it loads the CLAP model pinned in models.lock.json from the local cache with local_files_only=True and HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
Trainer._load_rng_state torch.load. The trial runs inference only and never constructs a Trainer
Malicious config.json in a remote model repository. Model files come from the pinned local cache, never from a repository resolved at run time
LightGlue loading path with trust_remote_code. The trial loads CLAP and Whisper only, without trust_remote_code
Path traversal in save_pretrained. The trial never saves a model or tokenizer
